Class.name: IHC.ITF.Operation.RadiantLogicProviderServiceCorpprvClient
Class.Description: Pull Radiant Logic updated records by calling the service

Method.name: processHttpsGetRequest
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK $$$TRACE("Inside Method processHttpsGetRequest")
Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New() Set pid =pRequest.StringValue $$$TRACE("Provider ID: "_pid)
set param="filter=providerID%20eq%20"_$CHAR(34)_pid_$CHAR(34) Set httprequest.ContentType="application/json" set url = ..Adapter.URL_"?"_param Set httprequest.Location = url Set httprequest.Authorization="Basic "_..credential $$$TRACE("Location: "_httprequest.Location) Set httprequest.SSLConfiguration = ..Adapter.SSLConfig $$$TRACE("SSL Config: "_httprequest.SSLConfiguration)
set tSC = httprequest.Get(url)
if $$$ISERR(tSC) { do $system.OBJ.DisplayError() Quit tSC } else { #dim tHttpResponse As %Net.HttpResponse set tHttpResponse=httprequest.HttpResponse Quit ..constructResponse(tHttpResponse, .pResponse) } quit tSC

Method.name: processHttpsPostRequest
Method.Description: Sends back a new unit number to Radiant Logic by calling the service PATCH api

Method.name: constructResponse
Method.Implementation: Set tSC=$$$OK $$$TRACE("StatusLine: "_pHttpResponse.StatusLine) set statusLine = pHttpResponse.StatusLine set statusCode = "" set statusDesc = "" if (statusLine'=""){ set statusCode=$piece(statusLine," ",2) set statusDesc=$piece(statusLine," ",3) } $$$TRACE("StatusCode: "_statusCode) $$$TRACE("StatusDesc: "_statusDesc) Set tbStream=##class(%GlobalBinaryStream).%New() Set tStatus = tbStream.CopyFrom(pHttpResponse.Data) $$$TRACE("tcharStream size:"_tbStream.Size) set text="" While 'tbStream.AtEnd { Set text = text_tbStream.Read($$$MaxStringLength) } $$$TRACE("Response:"_text_":"_pHttpResponse.ReasonPhrase) if ((statusCode'="200") && (statusCode'="201")){ $$$TRACE("Service call failed .... ") set tSC=$$$ERROR( "The service call failed with code: "_statusCode_" response: "_text) } else { $$$TRACE("Radiant Logic Service call success!") Set pResponse=##class(Ens.StringContainer).%New() set pResponse.StringValue=text } Quit tSC

Method.name: OnInit
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK set ..usrNm = ##class(Ens.Config.Credentials).GetValue(..Adapter.Credentials, "Username") set ..pswrd = ##class(Ens.Config.Credentials).GetValue(..Adapter.Credentials, "Password") set ..credential=$SYSTEM.Encryption.Base64Encode(..usrNm_":"_..pswrd)
Quit tSC
